dedupe_keys.name: amazon mining watch mining detector sentinel 2 detector of artisanal gold mining

description: An open-source deep learning model that detects mining scars in Sentinel-2 imagery across the Amazon basin. The GitHub repository says it uses an ensemble of convolutional neural networks on Sentinel-2 image patches, trained on 23,463 labelled patches, that the pipeline was rebuilt in August 2026, and that its detections are published on amazonminingwatch.org yearly for 2018 to 2025 and quarterly from 2025. The code is free on GitHub and outputs are downloadable from the site as map layers. Coverage is the Amazon basin. Caveats: detections are probabilistic and need review, and small or cloud-covered sites can be missed. For simulation it maps the spread of illegal mining that pollutes rivers and damages roads and forest, for exposure and impact studies. A related catalogue record is the WRI mining concessions dataset.
